usage: 雙皮奶 is a noun referring to a type of dessert. It is usually used as a subject or object in a sentence.
You can say '我好鍾意食雙皮奶' which means 'I really like to eat double skin milk pudding.'
When asking if someone has tried it, you can say, '你食過雙皮奶未？' meaning 'Have you tried double skin milk pudding?'
To order it in a restaurant, you might say, '我想要一碟雙皮奶' meaning 'I want one plate of double skin milk pudding.'
It is often used in casual conversations about food and desserts.
